package com.a;
import javax.baja.sys.*;
@NiagaraType
@NiagaraProperty(name = "maxStarts", type = "int", defaultValue = "6")
public class BPan extends BComponent {
  private final AlphaCfg alpha = new AlphaCfg();

    alpha.maxStarts = getMaxStarts();
    beta.maxStarts = getMaxStarts();
  }
}
